npcs.name: Vexa, the Last Watcher
npcs.description: A spare middle-aged woman in oiled leathers, her dark hair shorn close. A sealed-eye sigil hangs at her throat on a leather thong. Her eyes are tired and very steady — the eyes of someone who has watched the same horizon for a long time.
npcs.dialogueScript:
You came up from the foothills, then. Old Wren still alive? Good — tell her the line holds, just barely.

The Watcher's Barrow has gone wrong. Something old in the burial chamber stopped sleeping a few moons ago, and nothing I do from out here will put it back. The mound is sealed, and the only key I know of is the litany itself — four cairns out on the steppes, four watchers, in the right order. The order is carved on a tablet at the Lost Shrine, due west of the cairn field. Read it before you try the gate inside.

If you walk back out of that mound, find me. We will need to talk about what comes next.
